changed.before: Promotion shall not check an acceptance criterion, without limiting that prohibition to physical or order-related criteria.
changed.after: Promotion shall not check, satisfy, or waive physical or order-related acceptance criteria of CON-ARCH-004, CON-ARCH-006, CON-ARCH-007, or REL-ARCH-001, and shall not authorize production, PCBA/general-parts ordering, or reference BOM/CPL upload. The restriction expressly permits checking and completing OPS-ARCH-006 path-migration acceptance criteria.
